name: catalog-display
title: Catalog Display
author: uia
description: Catalog entries: Text, Badge, Note (alert line), Empty.

files.content:
import { z } from "zod" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/ds/status" import { Markdown } from "@/components/parts/markdown" import { defineComponent, tone } from "@/components/surface/catalog" // Display: words. Hierarchy by size and colour, never bold; one quiet line // for a note, a badge only for state. const BADGE_TONE = { neutral: "neutral", success: "success", warning: "warning", destructive: "destructive", attention: "attention", info: "info", } as const export const Text = defineComponent({ name: "Text", kind: "display", description: "Words. title: a heading; body; muted: secondary; eyebrow: a mono label; markdown: rich prose.", props: z.object({ text: z.string(), variant: z .enum(["title", "body", "muted", "eyebrow", "markdown"]) .optional(), }), render: (p) => p.variant === "markdown" ? ( {p.text} ) : (

{p.text}

), }) export const Badge = defineComponent({ name: "Badge", kind: "display", description: "A state, in one or two words (Healthy, 86% used, Over budget). Colour comes from tone.", props: z.object({ label: z.string(), tone: tone.optional() }), render: (p) => ( {p.label} ), }) export const Note = defineComponent({ name: "Note", kind: "display", description: "An alert line: a state badge plus one sentence with new information (when, how much, what happens next). Not advice.", props: z.object({ tone, badge: z.string(), text: z.string() }), render: (p) => (
{p.badge} {p.text}
), }) export const Empty = defineComponent({ name: "Empty", kind: "display", description: "Nothing here, said plainly in one line (and why, if it helps).", props: z.object({ title: z.string(), description: z.string().optional() }), render: (p) => (
{p.title} {p.description && ( {p.description} )}
), }) export const display = [Text, Badge, Note, Empty]
